data.long_meaning: The name Chiranjivi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Chira' meaning 'eternal' and 'Jivi' meaning 'living'. This name is bestowed upon individuals believed to possess the qualities of longevity, immortality, and vitality. In Hindu mythology, there are several gods and characters known as Chiranjivis, who are believed to have the power of eternal life.

data.etymology: Chiranjivi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Immortal, Everlasting.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chiranjivi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
